demo@ddu-mirror.local.Title: LinkedIn
demo@ddu-mirror.local.Description: In 2012 LinkedIn was breached and the passwords were not salted. The full extent of the incident only became public in 2016 when a much larger data set surfaced for sale.

demo@ddu-mirror.local.Title: Dropbox
demo@ddu-mirror.local.Description: In mid-2012 Dropbox suffered a breach exposing stored credentials for tens of millions of accounts. Passwords were hashed, with a portion using a weaker scheme.

demo@ddu-mirror.local.Title: Adobe
